name: Five Card Draw (Deuces Wild)
description: Five Card Draw with all twos wild. Same deal and draw as standard; deuces substitute for any card. Best hand wins.
alsoKnownAs: Five Card Draw Deuces Wild Poker

overview.description: Five Card Draw with all twos wild. Same deal and draw as standard; deuces substitute for any card. Best hand wins.

history.origins: Five Card Draw emerged as one of the oldest forms of poker and remained the best-known internationally until Texas Hold'em's rise in the late 20th century. Deuces Wild is a variation in which all four twos are wild; it is found mostly in home poker games and is typically played with players declaring their own hands rather than cards speaking for themselves.

setup.players: Two to six players; six is often considered best. With seven or eight the deck may run out during the draw, so six is the usual maximum.
setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack. All four deuces (twos) act as wild cards; no joker is used.

rules.objective: Form the best five-card hand; all four deuces are wild and substitute for any card. Five of a kind is the highest hand, beating a straight flush. Best hand at showdown wins the pot.
rules.gameplay: As Five Card Draw: one betting round, draw (discard and replace), second betting round, showdown.
keyRules: Same draw structure as base game

strategy.basic: Five of a kind possible; full houses and quads more common.

scoring.winCondition: Best 5-card hand wins. Twos are wild.
